address: GF, Conwell House, 34-38 Stanley Street, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Founded in 1957, this family business has been running at this spot since 2011. The unmissable, glistening roast geese are marinated with a secret recipe and go through over 20 preparatory steps before being chargrilled to perfection. You can order the goose by the quarter, best enjoyed with a bowl of lai fun noodles in clear broth with a drizzle of goose fat. Char siu, roast pork belly and soy-marinated chicken are also good....
